_comment: Canonical model registry + model cards. Each entry describes WHAT a model config is, so the leaderboard is self-documenting. `id` is stable (runs reference it — names can't collide). Edit here, then `npm run db:init` to sync. Card fields: kind (combo|single), components (the actual models in the config), base (finetune base, if any), tasks (which of the 4 it targets), released, notes.

models.name: Qwen+Gemini
models.notes: Qwen does OCR, Gemini does reasoning/extraction.

models.name: Chandra-only
models.notes: CPT base; LoRA adapters fine-tuned on top. The in-house track.

models.name: Chandra-4B full-FT
models.notes: In-house full fine-tune on the unified seg+cls task. Checkpoint captured per-run (e.g. ckpt-1200).

models.name: Gemma-4 12B
models.notes: LoRA fine-tune (unified seg+cls, v3). Checkpoint per-run (ckpt-300/600). Base loaded from the unsloth mirror on box 147.

models.name: Gemma-4 12B (base)
models.notes: Off-the-shelf instruct model, NO seg+cls finetune — the zero-shot baseline the in-house FTs must beat. Base loaded from the unsloth mirror on box 147.

models.name: Gemma-4 31B (base)
models.notes: Off-the-shelf instruct model, NO seg+cls finetune — larger zero-shot baseline. Loaded from /data/madhav/models/gemma-4-31B-it on box 147.
